overview.agricultural_zone_note: The dataset has no agro-climatic zone field.
overview.land_basis: Mean of the season records for the latest observed year.

coverage.last_dataset_update_basis: Most recent modification date of this district's CSV files.
provenance: Estimated (2024) - live download attempted from data.gov.in API (403), CGWB gwdata portal (maintenance mode), data.gov.in catalog (robots.txt blocked), agmarknet.gov.in (403); all unreachable from this environment on 2026-09-17. characteristics.title: Nitrogen status
characteristics.detail: Nitrogen status was Low in 2020 and Medium in 2023 (Kharif records).

characteristics.title: Phosphorus status
characteristics.detail: Phosphorus status was Low in 2020 and Medium in 2023 (Kharif records).

characteristics.title: Potassium status
characteristics.detail: Potassium status was Medium in 2020 and Medium in 2023 (Kharif records).

characteristics.title: Soil reaction (pH)
characteristics.detail: Average soil pH has remained stable: 6.50 in 2020 to 6.80 in 2023 (+4.6%), with low year-to-year variability (CV 0.019).

characteristics.title: Organic carbon
characteristics.detail: Organic carbon has increased: 0.54% in 2020 to 0.57% in 2023 (+5.6%), with low year-to-year variability (CV 0.023).

limitations.title: Organic carbon below 1%
limitations.detail: Organic carbon is 0.58% in 2023; the fertility index treats 1.0% as the level that earns a full organic-carbon score.

soil.crop_categories_basis: Crop types recorded for this district in crop.csv (observed years). The dataset has no soil-to-crop suitability table, so categories are what is grown here, not an agronomic recommendation; see Crop suitability for the computed ranking.

stress_indicators.title: Seasonal storage
stress_indicators.detail: Mean reservoir storage falls below 40% in Summer.

stress_indicators.title: Irrigation share of water demand
stress_indicators.detail: Irrigation's share of total water demand has remained stable: 73.8% in 2020 to 74.3% in 2023 (+0.7%), with low year-to-year variability (CV 0.003).

stress_indicators.title: Supply-demand balance
stress_indicators.detail: Deficit/surplus is recorded as 0 MCM in every month: the dataset sets demand equal to canal release, so it carries no shortage signal.

glossary.storage_pct: Reservoir storage as % of capacity; the fuzzy model's water input.
glossary.irrigation_share_pct: Irrigation's share of total water demand (irrigation + drinking + industrial).
glossary.groundwater_mbgl: Groundwater depth in metres below ground level (deeper = scarcer).
glossary.irrigated_pct: Irrigated land as % of agricultural land.
glossary.inflow_mcm: River inflow summed over the year, million cubic metres.

suitability.method: Score = mean of five 0–1 components, ×100: climate & soil (fuzzy crop confidence for the season), rainfall fit (effective rainfall ÷ crop water requirement, capped at 1), prominence (mean share of the season's sown area, relative to the most widely grown crop), yield stability (1 − coefficient of variation of observed yields) and resource efficiency (mean min–max goodness of cost, irrigation and environmental impact per hectare among the season's crops). Yield, cost, water and impact per hectare come from the optimiser's objective function for a one-crop, one-hectare plan at baseline input levels. Tonnage is shown but not scored, because tonnes of different crops are not comparable.

market.note: Historical prices from the dataset's MSP_Rs_Qtl column (observed years only), not live market data. Several crops listed have no government-notified MSP and the values have not been validated.

insights.title: Annual rainfall
insights.detail: Annual rainfall has remained stable: 706 mm in 2020 to 676 mm in 2023 (-4.2%), with low year-to-year variability (CV 0.018).

insights.title: Rainfall against the stated normal
insights.detail: Observed annual rainfall averages 693 mm, 13% below the 800 mm annual normal recorded in the dataset.

insights.title: When the rain falls
insights.detail: The Northeast Monsoon brings 39% of annual rainfall (≈270 mm a year); Southwest Monsoon 37%, Summer 22%, Winter 2%.

insights.title: Temperature
insights.detail: Mean annual temperature has remained stable: 29.0 °C in 2020 to 28.9 °C in 2023 (-0.1%), with low year-to-year variability (CV 0.001).

insights.title: Fastest production growth
insights.detail: Groundnut (Kharif) production changed +25.9% between 2020 and 2023 — area +19.7%, yield +5.0%.

insights.title: Slowest production growth
insights.detail: Sunflower (Rabi) production changed +17.8% between 2020 and 2023 — almost entirely from more area, with yield per hectare essentially flat.

insights.title: Yield consistency
insights.detail: Most consistent yield: Cotton (Kharif, CV 0.000); most variable: Maize (Kharif, CV 0.027).

insights.title: Kharif cropping pattern
insights.detail: Paddy holds the largest share of Kharif sown area (28%) among 5 crops — a diversified pattern.

insights.title: Rabi cropping pattern
insights.detail: Sugarcane holds the largest share of Rabi sown area (45%) among 3 crops — a diversified pattern.

insights.title: Summer cropping pattern
insights.detail: Vegetables holds the largest share of Summer sown area (57%) among 2 crops — a concentrated pattern.

insights.title: Irrigation dependency
insights.detail: Irrigated share of agricultural land has remained stable: 55.8% in 2020 to 57.9% in 2023 (+3.8%), with low year-to-year variability (CV 0.016).

insights.title: Reservoir records
insights.detail: Reservoir storage percentages are identical in every observed year for each month, so the data shows a seasonal pattern but no year-to-year change.

insights.title: Soil fertility index
insights.detail: Soil fertility index has increased: 62.2 in 2020 to 67.5 in 2023 (+8.5%), with low year-to-year variability (CV 0.043).

insights.title: Historical price growth
insights.detail: Paddy recorded the largest historical price rise in the dataset (+16.9%, unvalidated prices, not live market data).

insights.title: Highest suitability score
insights.detail: Sunflower (Rabi) has the highest suitability score, 73/100.

sentences: Salem grows 10 crops across 3 seasons; the largest by sown area are Paddy (Kharif), Maize (Kharif), Sugarcane (Rabi) (observed 2020–2023).
The highest crop-suitability scores are Sunflower in Rabi (73), Groundnut in Kharif (69), Maize in Kharif (68).
Annual rainfall averaged 693 mm and was stable over the observed years, with low variability; the Northeast Monsoon brings 39% of it.
Reservoir storage is lowest in Summer (38%, fuzzy set 'medium'); groundwater status is most often 'Normal'.
Soils are Red Loam with pH 6.8 and a fertility index of 67.5 (fuzzy set 'medium') in 2023.
Figures exclude 2024, whose rows are estimates.
summary.text: Salem grows 10 crops across 3 seasons; the largest by sown area are Paddy (Kharif), Maize (Kharif), Sugarcane (Rabi) (observed 2020–2023). The highest crop-suitability scores are Sunflower in Rabi (73), Groundnut in Kharif (69), Maize in Kharif (68). Annual rainfall averaged 693 mm and was stable over the observed years, with low variability; the Northeast Monsoon brings 39% of it. Reservoir storage is lowest in Summer (38%, fuzzy set 'medium'); groundwater status is most often 'Normal'. Soils are Red Loam with pH 6.8 and a fertility index of 67.5 (fuzzy set 'medium') in 2023.
